summary: 修订 1 策划案和意图记录已形成，产品取舍仍待制作人立项评审。原执行沙盒的解析器启动和 Git 写入失败已保留为失败尝试；主 Agent 在宿主环境重新运行定向检查并接管本地 Git 交付。

commands.command: npx tsx -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { parseProductIntentAlignment } from './scripts/product-intent.ts'; const p='docs/versions/pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24/intent-alignment.json'; const v=parseProductIntentAlignment(JSON.parse(readFileSync(p,'utf8')),'pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24','1'); console.log('intent contract OK; adjacent cases:',v.adjacentCases.length);"

node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p='docs/versions/pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24/',v=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p+'intent-alignment.json','utf8')),c=fs.readFileSync(p+'charter-draft.md','utf8'); if(v.schemaVersion!==1||v.versionId!=='pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24'||v.charterRevision!=='1'||v.adjacentCases.length<2||!v.adjacentCases.every(x=>c.includes(x.scenario))||!c.includes('未知/未发生'))process.exit(1); console.log('intent charter validation passed')"
